entries.name: Fränkisches Pils
entries.style: Pilsner brewed with the traditional brewing technique "Hopfenrösten" (hop roasting.) Whole leaf Spalter Select hops were boiled in concentrated wort, before rejoining the rest of the batch. This process lends a soft and saturated hop character, creating notes of earth and fruit well that are well integrated with the malt.

entries.name: ITALIAN PILS
entries.style: Young dry hopped Pilsner brewed with Spalter Select, Saphir and Perle hops from our favorite family hop farm in Tettnang.

entries.name: KELLERBIER
entries.style: Franconian Amber Kellerbier brewed with Pilsner, Vienna and Caramunich malts. Expressive Lager yeast aromatics over soft middle malts.

entries.name: PILSNER
entries.style: Classic German Pilsner brewed with German Pilsner malt, and the finest Tettnang-grown Hallertau Mittelfrüh and Saphir hops.

entries.name: PREMIUM LAGER
entries.style: An all-malt, patiently lagered and full-flavored beer made for everyone.

entries.name: Rauchbier Historische
entries.style: A Celebratory Beechwood Smoked Rauchbier brewed for Rauchbier Preservation Day. A lighter-bodied, but robust Lager brewed for summer drinking.

entries.name: SOMMER PILS
entries.style: Modern German Pils hopped with Callista hops. Callista means "most beautiful" in Greek, and this bright hop shines with a mix of classic noble, and modern fruity aromatics.

entries.name: Weißbier
entries.style: Bavarian Wheat Bier. An expressive and lively bouquet of vanilla, citrus, clove and banana bread on top of soft German white wheat. Designed for Biergarten drinking.
